company.description: Gimlet Labs is a startup that develops artificial intelligence infrastructure and applied research solutions that enable efficient execution of agent-based AI workloads across diverse computing environments. The company builds a platform that decouples AI workloads from specific hardware, allowing applications to be broken into components and dynamically assigned to the most suitable processors for execution. Its core offering includes an agent-native inference platform that supports the deployment and orchestration of multi-agent systems, combining large language models, custom code, and external data sources into unified pipelines. The platform manages scheduling, scaling, and optimization automatically, enabling users to run complex AI workflows without manual infrastructure management.
